name: TC-ANA-006 — Analytics field types: all numeric fields must be numbers not strings
description:
Verifies that every field in the `today` object is a proper JavaScript number, not a string.

Other dashboard endpoints (today-payments) have been found returning monetary values as strings. This test confirms whether analytics has the same issue.
